hero.headline:
Your Peaceful
Escape Near Saigon
hero.subheadline: Tucked into the green countryside of Đồng Nai, Hoang Long Homestay is a quiet retreat from city life — private, restful, and just minutes from Long Thanh International Airport

features.title: More Than a Place to Sleep
features.views_desc: Wake up surrounded by lush tropical greenery and fresh air — a peaceful garden sanctuary just a short drive from the city
features.breakfast_desc: Enjoy freshly brewed Vietnamese coffee, a selection of teas, and light snacks available at an additional cost — the perfect start to your morning
features.local_desc: Explore the villages and waterways of Đồng Nai, experience authentic local culture, and connect with the community

location.title: Perfectly Placed for Work & Travel
location.airport_desc: Hoang Long Homestay is just 10–15 minutes from Long Thanh International Airport — one of Vietnam's largest hubs. Arrivals, departures, and layovers have never been this easy.
location.industry_desc: Strategically located near major Đồng Nai industrial parks, we are the top choice for foreign engineers, specialists, and managers on long-term assignments. Monthly discounts available.

rooms.title: Our Rooms
rooms.no_rooms_desc: Try different dates or reduce the number of guests.
rooms.page_subtitle: Four distinct spaces, each shaped by the quiet character of Đồng Nai's countryside

room_descriptions.green_mountain: The most private and convenient room at Hoang Long. A cozy 26 m² retreat packed with everything you need — perfect for solo travellers or couples seeking calm and simplicity.
room_descriptions.ban_flower: The best street view in the house, enjoyed from a massive private balcony. This bright 35 m² room is ideal for guests who love watching the neighbourhood come alive each morning.
room_descriptions.family_room: One of our most spacious options at 45 m², with three large windows flooding the room with natural light and a private balcony. A favourite among long-stay professionals.
room_descriptions.deluxe: Our signature room. Three panoramic windows and a private balcony deliver light, space, and fresh air in abundance — the ultimate choice for an extended premium stay.

rules.smoking_rule1: All rooms and common areas are strictly non-smoking.
rules.smoking_outdoor: Smoking is only permitted in the designated outdoor area.
rules.damage_subtitle: All damage will be documented with photographic evidence and charged at the rates below.
rules.item_toilet: Toilet clog caused by improper use (e.g. flushing wipes or paper towels)
rules.trust_title: No Security Deposit — But Full Accountability
rules.trust_body: Hoang Long Homestay does not charge a security deposit — we trust our guests. However, this trust comes with full responsibility. Any damage to the room or property will be documented with photographic evidence and charged to the guest at the rates listed above. Damage fees are non-negotiable and must be settled within 24 hours of checkout. By completing your booking, you have already agreed to these terms. There are no exceptions.
rules.other_late_checkout: Late checkout fee: 100,000 VND / hour (max 3 hours, after which the full night rate applies)
rules.other_extra_guests: Unauthorized extra guests: 300,000 VND / person / night
